# iOS profile native screenshot gallery

Read [per-case results](report.md) and [source/build manifest](manifest.json) before interpreting these images. Baseline main06c5acd49a12; application fixbfecd4fea4af. Simulator screenshots are original driver 440×956 PNGs; XS Max originals are1125×2436. Display width below is presentation only; files are not resized. All data is synthetic. One absolute QA workspace path is masked; excluded captures are listed in the manifest.

## Reduce Motion — qualified native run

The real Settings switch was asserted `1` before this run and restored `0` afterwards. The first, unqualified switch-row tap recording is excluded. Contact sheet is a derived recording overview, not a separate native screenshot or performance measurement.
